title: SEO Chicago: Search and AI Answers for Chicago Firms | 22 Signals
description: SEO for Chicago companies, plus GEO so you show up in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overview answers. Technical fixes, content and monthly reports.
h1: SEO in Chicago, and showing up in AI answers too
intro: We do SEO for Chicago companies that want more inquiries from Google and from AI assistants. That covers technical fixes, local SEO across Chicagoland, content and generative engine optimization, so you show up in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overview answers. Our clients are mostly law firms, healthcare practices, manufacturers, B2B services and consumer brands.

sections.h: Why SEO in Chicago is harder than it looks
p: Chicago is a big, crowded search market. A personal injury firm in the Loop competes with dozens of firms for the same handful of phrases. A dental group in Lincoln Park competes block by block. A manufacturer in Elgin competes nationally for product searches but locally for hiring. And more of your buyers now ask an AI assistant instead of scrolling a results page.

Searchers here also think in neighborhoods and suburbs. People type Wicker Park, Logan Square, Hyde Park, Oak Brook, Naperville or Evanston into the search, not just the city name. That is the core of local SEO. Chicago searches need pages that reflect how people here actually search, without spinning up dozens of thin suburb pages that Google treats as spam.

list: Technical SEO: speed, crawling, indexing, structured data and fixing the errors that hold pages back.
Local SEO and Google Business Profile for each real location, with accurate categories, services and photos.
Content: service pages, practice area pages and guides written for the questions Chicago buyers ask.
How your business is described across the web: directories, review sites, industry lists and your own profiles, kept consistent.
Answer-first pages that AI assistants can quote, with clear facts near the top.
Outside mentions from relevant Chicago and industry publications.
Monthly reporting on rankings, traffic, inquiries and AI answer presence.

sections.h: Technical SEO, Chicago competition and where to start
p: In a market this size, the first gains usually come from fixing what is broken rather than writing more. Slow pages, duplicate location pages, missing structured data and a Google Business Profile in the wrong category are common on Chicago sites we audit. Fixing those often lifts rankings before any new content goes live.

Then comes content. For a Loop law firm that means accurate practice pages for each case type. For a suburban manufacturer it means capability pages written the way engineers search. For a clinic group it means one strong page per real location, not one page per suburb.

Generative engine optimization means making your business easy for AI assistants to understand, trust and mention. When someone asks for the best workers' compensation lawyer near the Loop or a reliable packaging supplier in the Chicago area, the assistant draws on pages that state clear facts, agree with each other across the web and answer the question directly.

In practice, generative engine optimization is good SEO with more attention on consistency, clear answers and outside mentions. We check a set of real buyer questions across the major AI engines, see who shows up, and fix the gaps.

list: Law firms: personal injury, workers' compensation and employment practices in the Loop and the suburbs, where every practice page has to be accurate on Illinois law.
Healthcare and aesthetics: clinics, dental groups and medspas across the North Side and the suburbs, with local profiles for each location.
Manufacturing and industrial: product and capability pages that rank nationally, with technical content buyers and engineers trust.
Professional services: accounting, consulting and insurance firms competing on expertise rather than ad budget.
Consumer and food brands: product and recipe pages, retailer finder pages and brand searches.

p: Right now, 10 of the businesses we work with sit in Google's top five for their main searches and show up in ChatGPT's answers. Some of that work is monthly SEO and content for US personal injury law firms, where we check every statute and deadline before a page goes live. That standard matters in Illinois, where getting a statute of limitations wrong on a practice page is a credibility problem.

list: Talk: a short call on goals, markets and what is already working.
Plan: a technical audit, a search and AI answer review, and a written 90-day plan.
Build: fixes, content and profile work, in priority order.
Grow: monthly reporting, new content and outside mentions, adjusted to what the data shows.

p: Our team runs your SEO. Chicago clients work with us remotely from London. Monthly reviews sit in your morning, our afternoon, and most of the work, from audits to content to fixes, does not need anyone on site. For Google Business Profile we work with your real addresses and photos; we never create fake locations.
Your Signal Lead owns the plan and the reporting, with specialist SEO, content and web teams behind them.

list: How competitive your searches are: a Chicago personal injury firm and a niche industrial supplier are very different jobs.
Number of locations and service areas.
Volume of content needed each month.
State of the site: technical debt adds work up front.
Whether web development or paid media are part of the same plan.

p: SEO works best on a fast, well-built site, so many clients pair it with web development. Paid media covers the searches you cannot rank for yet. Video and animation give your pages something worth linking to.

faqs.q: How long does SEO take in Chicago?
faqs.a: Expect early movement within a few months and stronger results over six to twelve, depending on competition and the state of your site. Technical fixes and Google Business Profile work often show results first. Highly contested Chicago searches, like personal injury, take longer than niche B2B terms. We report monthly so you can see progress.

faqs.q: Can you rank us in every Chicago suburb?
faqs.a: We can help you show up where you genuinely serve customers. We do that with real location pages, accurate service areas and content that mentions the places you work, not dozens of near-identical suburb pages. Google treats those as doorway pages and they tend to fail. Real offices and real reviews carry the most weight.

faqs.q: What is GEO and do Chicago businesses need it?
faqs.a: GEO, or generative engine optimization, helps your business show up in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overview answers. More Chicago buyers ask assistants for recommendations before they search, so it matters. It builds on SEO: clear answers, consistent facts across the web and mentions from trusted sources.

faqs.q: Do you do SEO for Chicago law firms?
faqs.a: Yes, it is one of our most experienced sectors. We write and maintain practice area content for US personal injury firms, check every statute and deadline, and handle technical SEO and local profiles. For Illinois firms we pay close attention to the state's rules and to accurate claims about results.

faqs.q: Do you need to visit our Chicago office?
faqs.a: No. SEO work is done remotely from London, with reviews on video in the Chicago morning. You share access to Search Console, analytics and your Google Business Profile, and we handle the rest. If photos of your location need refreshing, a local photographer or your own team can take them.

faqs.q: What does the monthly report show?
faqs.a: Rankings for your main searches, organic traffic, calls and form inquiries from search, Google Business Profile activity and how often you show up in AI answers for a fixed set of buyer questions. Each report also lists what we did that month and what comes next, in plain language.

faqs.q: Is SEO in Chicago different from SEO in the suburbs?
faqs.a: Yes, mostly in competition and in how people search. Downtown searches for law, healthcare and professional services are crowded and slow to win. Suburban searches, in places like Naperville, Schaumburg or Orland Park, often move faster if you have a real presence there. The method is still SEO. Chicago and suburban pages each need content that matches the area, not the same page with the town name swapped.
